description: Typed FIRMS VIIRS detections: one row per detection of the latest response, SP and NRT in one schema. Questionable rows are flagged, not deleted (filtering is a gold parameter). Only detections farther than the border buffer outside Ukraine and exact repeats are dropped. A point is the pixel center, not the fire's location.

schema.name: detection_id
schema.description: SHA-256 (32 hex) of source, latitude, longitude, acq_date and acq_time as sent

schema.name: acq_date_kyiv
schema.description: Calendar date of acq_time in Europe/Kyiv (gold aggregation day)

schema.name: h3_r9
schema.description: H3 cell, resolution 9 (about 0.1 km2); not for publishing

schema.name: satellite
schema.description: Satellite, from the FIRMS source id

schema.name: product
schema.description: sp (Standard Processing) or nrt (Near Real-Time), from version

schema.name: pass_id
schema.description: Overpass: satellite and first acq_time of the pass (gap > 20 min starts a new one)

schema.name: type
schema.description: SP only (null for NRT): 0 vegetation, 1 volcano, 2 static land, 3 offshore

schema.name: border_distance_km
schema.description: Distance to the border polygon, 0 inside

schema.name: is_persistent_hotspot
schema.description: h3_r9 cell active on many of the previous 365 days

schema.name: is_preferred
schema.description: Use this row: SP if the satellite has SP that day, else NRT

schema.name: flag_invalid_brightness
schema.description: bright_ti4 or bright_ti5 is <= 0 K (a FIRMS fill value, not a temperature); kept, not dropped

schema.name: fetched_at
schema.description: Request time of the bronze response

schema.name: run_id
schema.description: Dagster run that built the partition
